## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 166 captures during February 2019. Activity proceeded as scheduled, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 166 captures, 2 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.2. The result is recorded for monitoring of image acquisition and review performance during the month. No further qualification of the ungradable captures is provided in the site record.

## Grading

A total of 23 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 7 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and turnaround for the reporting period. Together with the capture and image-quality data, they provide the operational position for East City Eye Clinic in February 2019. The findings should be read alongside routine site monitoring, with particular attention to maintaining timely grading and minimising ungradable captures.
